# Hoop Impact Bench (HIB)

> Open, reproducible benchmark for NBA player impact metrics (RAPM, EPM, DARKO, LEBRON, BPM, xRAPM, Pulse, LOKI, ARC
> and your own). It scores each metric's preseason player ratings on the same 7,230 regular-season games (2020-21 to
> 2025-26) under the same rules, with 90% intervals and rank ranges from 2,000 resamples of team-seasons.
> Maintained by LUMA Basketball Research (lumahoops.org). Code MIT, data CC BY 4.0, copyright Court Share LLC.

## Use it
- Install: `pip install hoop-impact-bench`
- Score a metric: `hib --ratings my_metric.csv` (CSV columns: season, nba_id, rating; rating = points per 100 possessions vs average; season = the season the rating predicts)
- Verify published results: `hib-check`
- From source: `git clone https://github.com/lumahoops/hoop-impact-bench && python eval.py --ratings my_metric.csv`

## Tests
- Game margins (R²): share of each game's final margin explained by minutes-weighted team ratings
- Team win % (r): correlation of team-season ratings with win percentage (Narsu 2024)
- Team net error (RMSE): team rating at face value vs opponent-adjusted margin (Snarr 2020)
- Rebuilt rosters: the same tests on the third of games with the least returning minutes
- Rules: players under 250 minutes the season before (rookies included) and players missing from a file count as -2.0
